reviews.text: I was visiting the area for a couple months and the team at Groom and Board has been wonderful. I have a very, very small dog and had no concerns about his safety in their care. They were beyond accommodating. I look forward to coming back and visiting them again soon. I highly recommend!
I am Lola’s parent!! I loved the staff, the place, how nice everyone was, how well they took care of my Husky. Amazing location!!!! So good!!!

Been going to Groom & Board for almost two years after our grooming place closed in SJ. Our giant Pyrenees needs a lot of work and is kinda a big baby/sensitive but the best read out -- he's excited to go to the groomer which is a huge compliment.
They've also been helping us get the right tools and techniques to brush our pup out daily so he doesn't get mattes etc and truly care about the overall health of folks' pups. I'm can't speak more highly of the folks here.

Great spot with really nice people! We’ve booked our dog-son for daycare and boarding, both of which he’s really enjoyed. The team has answered any question we’ve had and have shared updates when we check in (which we do because we’re …
I called to ask how much they charge to trim cat nails. The lady who picked up told me they don't groom cats. …

Kelly has been our go-to groomer for our anxious dog for over two years now, and we couldn’t be happier. She is incredibly kind and patient with our dog, which is a huge relief for us. We highly recommend Kelly!
Love Groom & Board!! They’re amazing and truly care and love fur babies. I always recommend them to friends and family as they’re the only ones I trust with my little one :)
Great staff, very friendly and communicative.
